Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Performance qualification notes & request for prompt inventory

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get the qualification scheduled next week.

1) Fast priorities and targets (from the call):
   - 99th percentile tail latency target: 400 ms for single-turn text generation (max seq 512).
   - Sustained throughput target: 120 requests/minute across 6 concurrent worker threads (approx 20 req/min per worker).
   - Streaming requirement: sub-token streaming for multi-turn assistant flows (we discussed 50ms inter-token target).

2) What we need from your side to reproduce and qualify:
   - Prompt inventory (representative set across your three user intents) — CSV is fine.
   - Typical context length distribution (median & 95th).
   - Example concurrency pattern (burst windows, if any).

Action items I committed to:
   - Share our measurement definitions and the lightweight harness spec so your engineers can sanity check before we run (attached: perf-harness-spec.pdf).
   - Provide a template CSV for the prompt inventory (attached prompt-inventory.csv).
   - Map FastRetail intent -> Redwood prompt buckets so we can ensure fidelity on quality checks.

Next steps: if you can drop the prompt CSV and context stats by EOD Wed (7/14), Karthik and Dylan will schedule an isolated run in our staging Dedicated pool on Thursday and share raw traces + the measurement sheet.

Thanks — looking forward to the run.

—
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Grace — clear summary. Quick clarifications from our side before we assemble artifacts:

- The 400 ms 99th p95 target you captured aligns with product expectations, but to be explicit: this must hold for prompts up to 512 tokens and responses up to 256 tokens. Is that how you measure?
- For streaming: our client requires partial tokens emitted to the browser such that first-byte-to-first-subsequent-token delta is < 80ms; 50ms is aspirational. Can Redwood tune batching to honor that SLA in staging?
- Concurrency: the application has background syncs that create short 30s bursts of ~40 rps across the cluster. We can provide a minute-by-minute sample trace from our load generator.

We'll aim to get you the CSV + context distribution by Wed EOD. Also attaching one of our representative prompt templates in the reply (pasted below) to show format.

—
Alex Turner
Principal Product Manager, FastRetail
alex.turner@fastretail.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Performance qualification notes & request for prompt inventory

Alex — appreciate the quick clarifications. A few measurement details so expectations are aligned before we run: 

- Measurement definitions:
   * Latency: we report client-observed latency (request->final-token-emitted) and server-side scheduling latency (enqueue->first-token). Our 99th numbers include queuing under the chosen concurrency profile.
   * Throughput: measured as successful completed requests/minute excluding warmup. We'll run a 5-minute warmup then a 15-minute measurement window unless you prefer a different window.
   * Streaming: we'll emit tokens as soon as available; inter-token delta is measured at the server egress. We'll also capture packetization overhead so we can correlate with your network expectations.

- Reproducibility: to ensure comparable runs across teams, please: 
   1) Use the attached prompt-inventory.csv schema exactly (we'll validate input).
   2) Provide a sample run script or an excerpt of your load generator (minute-by-minute RPS) so we can replay bursts.

- Quality gating: we'll run automated similarity checks (BLEU/ROUGE + a small human spot-check) on a 50-sample subset to ensure quantization/batching changes don't regress outputs. If there are small deltas we'll include a side-by-side sample report.

I'll prepare the staging job once we get the CSV and the RPS trace. Grace — can you confirm the availability window for Dedicated staging on Thu?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Product — Inference, Redwood Inference

Alex — perfect, thanks for the details and for committing to Wed EOD. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- Yes, our 99th measurements will be run with prompts up to 512 and responses up to 256 unless you flag otherwise in the CSV. We'll include both client-observed and server-scheduling latency fields in the report.
- We'll attempt to hold inter-token delta at ~50ms in staging but will surface server+network breakdowns so we can triage.
- Please upload: prompt-inventory.csv (use the template), context-length-stats.csv (median/95th), and an rps-trace.json (minute granularity). Drop them in the Drive link below or reply to this thread.

Drive link for artifacts: https://drive.reddemo.com/fastretail/perf-harness-spec

I'll also upload an annotated example of our measurement CSV later this morning to the Drive link.
